entities.summary: Astrology consists of a number of belief systems that hold that there is a relationship between astronomical phenomena and events or descriptions of personality in the human world. Astrology has been rejected by the scientific community for having no explanatory power for describing the universe. Scientific testing has found no evidence to support the premises or purported effects outlined in the astrological traditions.
